title: The Cultural Gene of Large Language Models: A Study on the Impact of Cross-Corpus Training on Model Values and Biases
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark, the Cultural Probe Dataset (CPD), was designed to evaluate models along cross-cultural psychological dimensions, specifically Individualism-Collectivism (IDV) and Power Distance (PDI).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
